stories.title: New schoolwear shop opens in Mold town centre
stories.summary: A new schoolwear shop has opened on Chester Street in Mold. WUC Schoolwear Mold is based at 13–15 Tudor House and opened on 22 June. stories.title: More than 20,000 late cancellations hit Welsh patient transport service
stories.summary: More than 20,000 non-emergency ambulance journeys across Wales have been cancelled at short notice so far this year, prompting the Welsh Ambulance Service to urge patients to cancel bookings as early as possible if they no longer need transport. stories.title: Swimmers warned over hidden dangers in Wales’ rivers and lakes this summer
stories.summary: Natural Resources Wales and Public Health Wales are urging people to take care when swimming in open water this summer, as hot weather leads more people to rivers, lakes and the sea to cool off. stories.title: Coastguard pay cut plans dropped after volunteers threatened to quit
stories.summary: Plans to stop paying coastguard rescue officers for their time on call-outs and training have been dropped, after some threatened to quit over the move. stories.title: Doritos Chilli Heatwave recalled over undeclared milk
stories.summary: PepsiCo is recalling Doritos Chilli Heatwave crisps after some packs were found to contain milk that is not listed on the label.
